message.trueaura.on: True Aura: ON — use third-person view to see your aura
screen.trueaura.title: True Aura
screen.trueaura.reset_hint: Restore defaults in the preview. Save to keep them.
screen.trueaura.shape_hint: Open the list and choose any aura shape directly.
screen.trueaura.hex_hint: Enter six RGB hex digits, for example FFB30F or #FFB30F.
screen.trueaura.draft_hint: Save to apply. Cancel or Esc discards changes.
screen.trueaura.world_required: Join a world to see the live aura preview. You can still edit and save here.
screen.trueaura.preview_hint:
Live preview
Only you see unsaved changes.
screen.trueaura.effects.title: Effects
screen.trueaura.effects.parameters_hint: Extra particle arguments only. Empty for simple particles. Test stays local.
screen.trueaura.effects.tested: Preview played locally. Save to apply to real toggles.
screen.trueaura.effects.context_required: Needs an attack animation or projectile. Not usable as a standalone aura burst.
screen.trueaura.effects.laser_context: Needs a beam target and emits along a long ray. Not available as an aura burst.
screen.trueaura.effects.missing_mod: Source mod is missing here. Original burst is used as fallback.
screen.trueaura.effects.invalid_paramete: Arguments are invalid. Check both On/Off choices; use the particle command format.
screen.trueaura.effects.world_required: Join a world to test an effect.
screen.trueaura.effects.not_visible: Stand in view and alive to test; the original burst needs dry ground.
screen.trueaura.effects.cooldown: Wait a moment before testing again.
screen.trueaura.effects.ground_required: Stand on solid ground for Ground Slam.
screen.trueaura.effects.provider_unavail: Particle could not be created here. Original burst used instead.
screen.trueaura.picker.palette_hint: Drag left/right for color strength and up/down for brightness.
screen.trueaura.picker.keyboard: Use arrow keys to adjust the color.
screen.trueaura.picker.narration: %s, %s. Hue %s degrees, saturation %s percent, brightness %s percent.
message.trueaura.command_updated: Aura updated by a server command. Saved settings and any open preview have been refreshed.
command.trueaura.shape: Unknown aura shape. Use Tab to see the available shapes.
command.trueaura.color: Unknown color. Use a name such as gold/blue/pink or six hex digits such as FFB30F.
command.trueaura.effect_invalid: Invalid or overly long particle arguments.
